data.gender_notes: Esau is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Esau is recorded in name-lists as “Older brother of Jacob”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Esau expresses “Older brother of Jacob”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esau total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: עֵשָׂו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עֵשָׂו הוא שם עברי שמופיע בתנ״ך, ומשמעותו היא הוא עשוי להיות שעיר, מהמילה עשו שפירושה שעיר, והוא אחי יעקב, בנו הבכור של יצחק ורבקה

in_greek.name: Ἠσαῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠσαῦ ἐστιν ὄνομα Ἑβραϊκόν, τὸ ὃπερ σημαίνει ἀνὴρ πίλου, καὶ ἀναφέρεται εἰς τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ Ἰακώβ, υἱὸν τοῦ Ἰσαάκ καὶ τῆς Ρεβέκκας

in_latin.name: Esau
in_latin.long_meaning: Esau est nomen Hebraicum, quod significat pilus est, et refertur ad fratrem Jacobi, filium Isaac et Rebeccae, et est unus e duobus filiis Isaac
